claim.claim-text: 1. A method in an electronic device (400) configured to communicate through a wireless air interface with a home public land mobile network, PLMN, and visiting PLMNs, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising:
storing (804) the first security key; storing (810) the second security key;
3. The method of any of claims 1-2 wherein the protected message comprises one of a UDM parameter update message or a steering of roaming message.
4. The method of any of claims 1-3, further comprising:

generating a first time stamp indicating a time when the first security key is generated and associating the first time stamp with the first security key; and generating a second time stamp indicating a time when the second security key is generated and associating the second time stamp with the second security key.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein determining which of the first security key and the second security key is the latest security key comprises:
6. The method of any of claims 1-3, further comprising:

incrementing a counter when the first security key is generated and associating the value of the counter with the first security key; and incrementing the counter when the second security key is generated and associating the value of the counter with the second security key.
7. The method of claim 6, wherein determining which of the first security key and the second security key is the latest security key comprises:
8. The method of any of claims 1-7, further comprising:

responsive to the first security key being the latest security key (1100), deleting (1102) the second security key; and responsive to the second security key being the latest security key (1100), deleting (1102) the first security key.

9. The method of claim 8 wherein deleting (1102) the second security key comprises deleting the second security key responsive to the first security key being stored and deleting (1104) the first security key comprises deleting the first security key responsive to the second security key being stored.
10. The method of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the first PLMN is a visiting PLMN, VPLMN, and the second PLMN is a VPLMN.
11. An electronic device (400) configured to communicate through an interface with a home public land mobile network, PLMN, and visiting PLMNs, the electronic device (400) comprising:

12. The electronic device (400) of claim 11, wherein the memory includes further instructions that when executed by the at least one processor (403) cause the electronic device (400) to perform the method according to any one of claims 2 to 10.
